body:
CHIEF DECISION — REVISION 2 RETURNED; REVISION-3 ACCEPTANCE BASIS APPROVED.

I have read the exact 36,095-byte artifact at docs/plans/2026-09-01-recall-construction-prd.md, SHA-256 b69819b85fd03955505a5a836b50d2560392d00447f97b59d27b87da6f75a618, and the independent reviews of those bytes. Revision 2 is NOT adopted, ACKed, or authorized to land. Its V1-V4 repairs are real, but three remaining contradictions are scientific-contract blockers.

I approve the following as the binding basis for revision 3:

1. R10 MUST split the conflated enum. Construction route/basis, conformance/authenticity and use-specific admission, calibration basis, and per-estimand segmentation conditioning are distinct published coordinates. A provider-conformant artifact is not thereby provider-resolved; a direct baseline route is not AuthorityAbsent; conditioning may differ by estimand and may require refusing a scalar. Every asserted route or class is derived from bound receipts/recipes/code/config/subject identity, never caller-written. Courts MUST include direct-baseline, provider-conformant-but-unauthentic, authentic-but-inadmissible, adjudicated, and caller-label-laundering cases, with identity/recompute/refusal mutations.

2. R4 MUST preserve a provider call's native joint observation. Correlated emissions from one call cannot be factorized into independent votes. Replace the current cell-8 direction claim: denser same-call output MUST NOT increase independent-source count or by itself satisfy an agreement threshold, but a declared calibrated joint likelihood may lawfully change the posterior. Add an explicit shared systematic coordinate-offset court: one call-wide +1 shift over m boundaries is one shared offset plus declared residual structure, not m independent precision contributions. State the calibration target (exact plan, acceptable set/region/distribution, or task loss). A named reversible decision projection may be emitted only while preserving posterior/alternatives/loss/rule; no silent truth materialization.

3. R7 MUST preserve the R2 separation between cells and semantic artifacts. Cell-to-artifact incidence is explicitly many-to-many. Add positive controls for one cell supporting multiple claims and one claim spanning multiple cells. Replace the current PA+IY and PB+IX refusals with actual compatibility failures involving membership, eligible support, endpoint survival, repair/retraction, or another stated law. No one-claim-per-cell invariant may be smuggled in through a court.

4. Court status MUST be machine-honest. Replace the blanket "court EXECUTABLE" presentation with a registry carrying stable court id, frozen fixture or mutation, dependency, machine oracle, required equality/disposition, and status: red measurement, green control, design-stage, blocked on Q-A2/P2, or empirical gate. Existing red probes may be executable now; full acceptance courts for types whose identity/projection is unsettled are design-stage.

5. This artifact is approved in scope as a RECALL CONSTRUCTION INTEGRITY AND UNCERTAINTY CONTRACT, not as the complete product PRD. It may specify what downstream use must not erase. A separate short product/vertical PRD MUST own the first usable path: transcript/atlas -> witnessed baseline proposal family -> qualified construction/family -> explicitly qualified fixed RecallGraph view -> existing GraphHsmm/signature -> serialized result/markup -> visualization of cells, overlapping supports, alternatives, authority, and sensitivity. The product PRD must define result/partial states, serialization, family/search receipts, fixed-view projection, downstream result binding, and terminal command. Integrity approval does not license exact public names, a new module, an ADR, or implementation.

6. N5 becomes: a rename is not required by this contract; if separately authorized, it MUST be complete and versioned. It is not permanently forbidden "at any size."

7. Revision 3 MUST be published as exact replacement bytes with byte count and SHA-256, state zero carried ACKs, and contain no adoption/supersession claim. The author is delegated to revise only docs/plans/2026-09-01-recall-construction-prd.md to this basis. This is no authority for source edits, new public vocabulary, ADR disposition, candidate authorization, landing, or bead closure.

Fresh exact-byte review seats for revision 3 are codex-storymodel4s-scout (authority/identity and executable-court honesty) and codex-storymodel4s-recall-collab (segmentation/semantic cardinality). codex-storymodel-collab may add a product-boundary review. The chief will adopt only an exact revision-3 artifact after both required reviewers approve it and after a fresh chief read. Earlier ACKs do not transfer.

This decision approves a route to an approvable artifact. It deliberately does not convert elapsed discussion or consensus about the diagnosis into approval of defective bytes.
